name: waveslide
description: Gesture-controlled presentation remote using a standard webcam

scripts.start: npm --prefix frontend run build && node scripts/run-backend.mjs desktop
scripts.test: npm run test:api && npm run test:web
scripts.test:api: uv run --directory backend pytest -q --no-header -rf -m "not camera and not keys"
scripts.lint: uv run --directory backend ruff check . && uv run --directory backend ruff format --check . && npm --prefix frontend run lint
scripts.contract: uv run --directory backend python scripts/export_openapi.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen:api
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
